summary: Alert mails are calmer and easier to act on.

fixes.title: Alert mails are easier to act on
fixes.text: Alert mails start with the environment name and a calm summary, then the facts, the cause and the fix in plain words, and one button. Technical details come last.

fixes.title: Clear error for a missing Power BI workspace
fixes.text: A Power BI workspace that cannot be found now has its own clear error.
